items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Well Ridley, I played with Ridley, returned to houses, all uptown, and Emma Barrett was playing

ctx.x: Yeah. And what about Ridley's band? Well Ridley, I played with Ridley, returned to houses, all uptown, and Emma Barrett was playing And Emma Barrett was playing in that band, and Gilbert Young was playing in that band, and Happy was on drums, Happy Goldston was playing drums. And I believe I saw you one day when you was going up there to do what you're doing with me with Papa before he died up on Edinburgh's day.
